guideline.label: Career effective dose
guideline.description: Total effective dose from every flight in the career. Stays under the 3 % excess lifetime cancer mortality threshold.

assessments.protocol: Inside the limit. Continue the routine monitoring.

guideline.label: Daily GCR exposure
guideline.description: Galactic cosmic ray rate on missions longer than 60 days. Each interval reading is the dose for the day it is logged on, so the rate is the window total over the days that were logged. Tighter on a planetary surface, where the ground provides some shielding.

assessments.protocol: Set the habitat on the Radiation page to evaluate the daily GCR rate.

guideline.label: Lens (30 days)
guideline.description: Prevents early severe cataracts from acute exposure.

guideline.description: Guards the central nervous system against acute neurological effects.

assessments.protocol: Log a radiation reading to assess this limit.

guideline.label: SPE alert
guideline.description: Effective dose inside a solar particle event. When it approaches the limit the crew shelters in the most shielded part of the vehicle.

assessments.protocol: No solar particle event is open or recorded.
